title: The Weather App — EN/ES/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish German language learning technology Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The weather app says forty percent chance of rain at three
And I make decisions based on that particular certainty
That isn't quite certainty — it's an assessment of the possible
Which I've translated into definitely — that's the plausible

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La aplicación del tiempo dice cuarenta por ciento de lluvia a las tres
[The weather app says forty percent chance of rain at three]
Y tomo decisiones basadas en esa certeza que a veces no es
[And I make decisions based on that certainty that sometimes isn't]
Certeza real — es una estimación de lo posible
[Real certainty — it's an assessment of the possible]
Que traduzco como definitivo — es lo más admisible
[That I translate as definite — it is the most admissible]

[Chorus — English]
The weather app knows something I don't know
It knows the models and the satellites and the wind's preferred flow
The weather app has seventeen data inputs from around the sky
And still can't tell me if I need an umbrella — and that's why
That's my boy

[Bridge — German, with English translation]
Die Wetter-App sagt vierzig Prozent Regenwahrscheinlichkeit um drei
[The weather app says forty percent chance of rain at three]
Und ich treffe Entscheidungen basierend auf dieser Gewissheit frei
[And I make decisions based on this certainty freely]
Die keine wirkliche Gewissheit ist — nur eine Einschätzung
[Which is not a real certainty — just an assessment]
Die ich als definitiv übersetze — das ist meine Schätzung
[Which I translate as definite — that is my estimate]

[Outro — All three languages]
Weather app knows… La app del tiempo sabe… Die Wetter-App weiß
Forty percent chance of everything — Cuarenta por ciento de probabilidad de todo — Vierzig Prozent Wahrscheinlichkeit für alles
That's my boy
